notes.zh-CN: Codex 与 Kimi 现在可以在一台机器上并存多个账号：每个账号有独立的配置目录（CODEX_HOME / KIMI_CODE_HOME），登录态、会话与历史互不干扰。到「设置 › 账号」里添加账号、设为默认，或点「登录」在已指向该目录的终端窗口里完成登录；输入框旁的账号选项会在同一目录开启新会话。OpenCode 仍走它自己的多凭据列表，切换对所有会话同时生效。
notes.en: Codex and Kimi can now keep several accounts side by side: each account is its own configuration directory (CODEX_HOME / KIMI_CODE_HOME), so sign-ins, sessions and history never mix. Add an account in Settings › Account, make it the default, or press Sign in to run the CLI's login in a Terminal window that already points at that directory. The account menu beside the composer starts a new session in the same folder. OpenCode keeps using its own credential list, whose switch applies to every session.
